FDA notice: accelerated approval for Jemperli (dostarlimab, GSK) on October 19, 2026 for adults with Stage II/III locally advanced rectal cancer that is MSI-H or dMMR.
Adults with Stage II/III LARC that is MSI-H or dMMR (dMMR/MSI-H expansions are the brief's own explanation).
Search summary of FDA notice: approval came four months before the FDA goal date; dostarlimab also received Breakthrough Therapy designation (and Priority Review).
AZUR-1 (NCT05723562): multicenter, single-arm, open-label trial in 154 patients with previously untreated MSI-H/dMMR Stage II/III LARC. 'Phase 2' and 'alone' not explicitly in retrieved text.
claims.newSentence: The FDA says the approval relied on interim results from AZUR-1, a single-arm, open-label study in patients with previously untreated dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer.

claims.evidence: Press announcement: because this is an accelerated approval based on interim results, the sponsor must continue following patients to show lasting clinical benefit.
